name: docmost-knowledge
description: Search, maintain, organize, cite, and resolve freshness-verified Catalog bundles in private Docmost knowledge bases through Keychain-authenticated MCP connections.

interface.shortDescription: Use a private Docmost knowledge base safely from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Docmost Knowledge gives Codex permission-aware directory-scoped search, atomic page-tree organization, page editing, AI-oriented template, version history, attachment, vector-index, and optional signed Catalog Bundle and Delta workflows across personal or company profiles. A local stdio proxy reads bearer tokens from macOS Keychain, validates Catalog v2 proofs and graph closure, bounds remote responses, and forwards requests only over HTTPS without storing credentials in the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Search my Docmost knowledge base before answering.
Save these notes to the appropriate Docmost space.
Create this Docmost page with the best matching published template.
